method: close outcome at neutral-probe window>=5; countdown treated as incidental UI capture, not rate-limit
conclusions: Close is content-deterministic, NOT a load artifact (clean 100%/0% split at matched high windows, 20-35 trials/flag).
NOT prefix matching: fox (non-que English phrase) closes 100%.
NOT corpus membership: fernando (corpus phrase) stays open 0%.
No simple lexical rule (length, char-diversity, language, dictionary words, underscores) separates closers from openers.
Most likely an unidentified content-scoring threshold (possibly model perplexity), unconfirmed.
KEY: closing != correct. fox is definitely not the flag yet closes identically to alma. SSH close is a meaningful content signal but not a correctness oracle.
